title: Class 12 Chemistry Equation Bank - Tamil Nadu State Board
notation: Chemical equations use LaTeX with the mhchem package (\ce{...}); physical-chemistry formulas use standard LaTeX.
coverage_note: Only equations physically present in the uploaded source text were extracted. During PDF-to-Markdown conversion, a substantial number of equations in the original textbook (especially in Chapter 1 Metallurgy and Chapter 2 p-Block Elements-I, and scattered elsewhere) were rendered as images/equation-objects and were dropped, leaving blank gaps in the source files where an equation is referenced in the surrounding text but not recoverable. These gaps were intentionally skipped rather than reconstructed, per instruction. Chapters 6-10 (Solid State, Kinetics, Ionic Equilibrium, Electrochemistry, Surface Chemistry) retained their core formulas well; Chapters 1, 2, 11-15 have more gaps because more content was lost in conversion.
